name: WF-431 — Lead Acquisition Forecast → Budget Demand & Pipeline Capacity Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'default').trim(); const forecastPeriods=Math.max(1,Math.min(12,Number(b.forecastPeriods??3))); const targetClosedDeals=Number.isFinite(Number(b.targetClosedDeals))?Number(b.targetClosedDeals):null; const targetNetProfit=Number.isFinite(Number(b.targetNetProfit))?Number(b.targetNetProfit):null; const availableBudget=Number.isFinite(Number(b.availableBudget))?Number(b.availableBudget):null; return [{json:{...b,portfolioId,forecastPeriods,targetClosedDeals,targetNetProfit,availableBudget,asOfDate:b.asOfDate??new Date().toISOString(),receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Acquisition Forecast Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const hist=Array.isArray(ctx.periods)?ctx.periods:[]; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):0; const avg=(key)=>hist.length?hist.reduce((s,p)=>s+n(p[key]),0)/hist.length:0; const leadsAvg=avg('leads'),qualifiedAvg=avg('qualifiedLeads'),contractsAvg=avg('contracts'),closedAvg=avg('closedDeals'),profitAvg=avg('netProfit'),spendAvg=avg('spend'); const qRate=leadsAvg?qualifiedAvg/leadsAvg:0; const cRate=qualifiedAvg?contractsAvg/qualifiedAvg:0; const closeRate=contractsAvg?closedAvg/contractsAvg:0; const leadToClose=leadsAvg?closedAvg/leadsAvg:0; const profitPerClosed=closedAvg?profitAvg/closedAvg:0; const spendPerLead=leadsAvg?spendAvg/leadsAvg:0; const forecast=[]; for(let i=1;i<=input.forecastPeriods;i++){const trend=Math.max(-0.25,Math.min(0.25,n(ctx.trendRate??0)));const factor=Math.pow(1+trend,i);const projectedLeads=leadsAvg*factor;const projectedQualified=projectedLeads*qRate;const projectedContracts=projectedQualified*cRate;const projectedClosed=projectedContracts*closeRate;const projectedProfit=projectedClosed*profitPerClosed;const projectedSpend=projectedLeads*spendPerLead;forecast.push({period:i,projectedLeads,projectedQualifiedLeads:projectedQualified,projectedContracts,projectedClosedDeals:projectedClosed,projectedNetProfit:projectedProfit,projectedSpend});} const final=forecast[forecast.length-1]??{}; const closedGap=input.targetClosedDeals!==null?input.targetClosedDeals-final.projectedClosedDeals:null; const profitGap=input.targetNetProfit!==null?input.targetNetProfit-final.projectedNetProfit:null; const additionalLeads=closedGap>0&&leadToClose>0?closedGap/leadToClose:0; const incrementalBudget=additionalLeads*spendPerLead; const budgetDemand=input.availableBudget!==null?Math.max(0,incrementalBudget-input.availableBudget):incrementalBudget; let action='maintain_current_acquisition_capacity'; if(closedGap>0||profitGap>0)action=incrementalBudget>0?'increase_acquisition_budget_and_pipeline_capacity':'improve_funnel_conversion_before_scaling'; else if(closedGap!==null&&closedGap<0&&profitGap!==null&&profitGap<0)action='maintain_or_reduce_acquisition_spend'; const idempotencyKey='wf431:'+input.portfolioId+':'+input.forecastPeriods+':'+input.asOfDate; return [{json:{...input,acquisitionForecast:{status:hist.length?'forecasted':'blocked',baseline:{leadsAvg,qualifiedAvg,contractsAvg,closedAvg,profitAvg,spendAvg,qualificationRate:qRate,contractRate:cRate,closeRate,leadToClose,profitPerClosed,spendPerLead},forecast,capacityAssessment:{targetClosedDeals:input.targetClosedDeals,targetNetProfit:input.targetNetProfit,closedDealGap:closedGap,netProfitGap:profitGap,additionalLeadsRequired:additionalLeads,incrementalBudgetRequired:incrementalBudget,budgetDemandGap:budgetDemand},recommendedAction:action,flags:hist.length?[]:['no_historical_acquisition_data'],confidenceScore:hist.length>=3?90:hist.length?72:25},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Forecasting and capacity planning is recommendation scaffolding pending verified historical acquisition schema, calibrated forecasting model, canonical spend source, and production InsulaCRM analytics contracts.
